create_client_openai: create an OpenAI client with a custom base_url pointing to the Hugging Face router and an API key from environment
create_chat_completion_stream: create a streaming chat completion with a multimodal message containing text and an image URL
iterate_stream_chunks: iterate over streamed chat completion chunks and print each delta content
build_multimodal_message: build a multimodal message with text and image_url content parts for a vision-language model
configure_openai_client_env: configure an OpenAI client using an environment variable for the API key and a custom base URL
